clue.text: Apartment agent returned neat and tidy

indicators.note: returned tells us each of the two words for apartment and agent is turned round where it stands

parts.note: a pad is slang for a flat or apartment
a rep (representative) is a sales agent

explanation.surface: A flat's letting agent came back looking smart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returned' turns each piece in place: PAD becomes DAP and REP becomes PER.
explanation.definitionFit: Dapper describes someone smartly turned out, trim and spruce in dress.

clue.text: Many thrown out are unhappy

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for 500, a crossword stand-in for many
ejected means expelled or thrown out

explanation.surface: Lots of people expelled from a place feel miserable about it.
explanation.definitionFit: Dejected is a synonym: downcast, low in spirits.

clue.text: Attic poet's terrible slip

indicators.note: terrible says the letters of the words before it are in a bad state, to be rearranged

parts.note: the possessive 's adds no letter, so this gives the word poet

explanation.surface: A garret-dwelling poet makes an awful blunder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'terrible' rearranges ATTIC and POET; 'slip' looks like an error but is the undergarment.
explanation.definitionFit: A petticoat is a woman's underskirt, also called a slip.

clue.text: Food worries

definitions.meaning: ... is informal for food, as in 'good ...'
something that ... at you worries or troubles you

explanation.definitionFit: Slang 'eats' means grub, and to eat at someone is to nag at their mind with worry.

clue.text: Fall in pollution

parts.note: a fall here is a fall of precipitation, one that has been tainted by industrial pollutants

explanation.surface: A drop in pollution levels is reported.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests pollution falling; read 'Fall' as weather falling from the sky, made corrosive by pollution.
explanation.definitionFit: Precipitation acidified by sulphur and nitrogen emissions comes down as a polluted shower.

clue.text: Intimate conversation with extended family

definitions.meaning: to talk closely and intimately, and the noun once meant such a talk
a community living together and sharing everything, like an enlarged household

explanation.definitionFit: The word covers both a close exchange of thoughts and a group of people sharing a home and property.

clue.text: Rank bad law designed to achieve nothing

indicators.note: designed means these letters are worked into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A terrible statute drafted so that it accomplishes nothing at all.
explanation.walkthrough: 'designed' rearranges RANK, BAD and LAW together.
explanation.definitionFit: To draw a blank is an idiom for failing to get any result.

clue.text: Excuse to bail out before one

indicators.note: before places the rearranged letters ahead of the next piece
out signals that the letters of bail are put out of order

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A pretext to jump bail ahead of something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' looks like part of 'bail out', jumping bail, but it is the anagram signal; 'before' sets the scrambled bail ahead of one.
explanation.definitionFit: An alibi is a claim of being elsewhere, used as an excuse.

clue.text: Identifying new article on china

indicators.note: in a down clue, on means the earlier pieces sit on top of the next

parts.note: a is the indefinite article
Ming is a Chinese dynasty famous for its porcelain

explanation.surface: Picking out a recent piece placed on the porcelain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'china' is not the country but fine porcelain, of which Ming is the best-known kind.
explanation.definitionFit: Naming something is pointing it out by name, specifying which it is.

clue.text: One often taken for a mug?

definitions.text: One often taken for a mug?

parts.words: One often taken for a mug?
parts.note: a mug suggests a gullible person, but here it is a drinking vessel that a smaller cup is often mistaken for

explanation.surface: A gullible person who is frequently fooled.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taken for a mug' sounds like being treated as a fool; read literally, it is a cup confused with a mug.
explanation.definitionFit: A small china cup with a handle can be confused with a larger drinking vessel.

clue.text: High winds in Blackburn

parts.note: split the town name: its first half, black, is jet, a glossy black stone
its second half, burn, is a Scottish word for a stream

explanation.surface: Strong gales blowing in the Lancashire town of Blackburn.
explanation.walkthrough: BLACKBURN is a town in Lancashire; split it as BLACK and BURN, burn being Scots for a brook.
explanation.definitionFit: Jet streams are fast currents of air high in the atmosphere.

clue.text: Man chasing kiss accepted reality

indicators.note: chasing means the following piece comes after the one before it

parts.note: A is an abbreviation for accepted, as marked on a bill of exchange
X stands for a kiss at the end of a letter
IOM is the abbreviation for the Isle of Man

explanation.surface: A man in pursuit of a kiss accepts how things really are.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Man' is the Isle of Man, IOM, which 'chasing' places after A and X.
explanation.definitionFit: An axiom is a self-evident truth, a principle taken as established fact.

clue.text: Inscribed copy

annotationWithheld.why: Clue 'Inscribed copy (4)': CRIB is hidden in 'Inscribed', but the only hidden-word signal is the same word read as 'in scribed', so one word is both fodder and indicator, which the check refuses.

clue.text: Calling for possession of territory

definitions.meaning: a calling is a vocation or profession
a military force holding and controlling land it has taken

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a job or trade and the act of seizing and holding land.

clue.text: Fail to progress float of corporation

annotationWithheld.why: Clue as held 'Fail to progress float of corporation (5,5)': 'Fail to progress' defines TREAD WATER, but 'float of corporation' gives no parse for it and no reprint was found; likely garbled.
annotationWithheld.clue: Fail to progress float of corporation

clue.text: Say nothing to upset one's own promotion

parts.note: eg (for example) is a way of saying 'say'
O is the round figure zero, nothing
to trip someone is to upset them, making them fall

explanation.surface: Keep quiet so as not to annoy someone about your own advancement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to' is only a link; 'upset' supplies a synonym, not an anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: An ego trip is self-indulgent activity done to boost one's own importance.

clue.text: Culinary delight of city in boiled rice

indicators.note: in places the city inside the rearranged letters
boiled suggests rice being churned around, so its letters are rearranged

parts.note: LA is Los Angeles

explanation.surface: A tasty dish from a city, served in boiled rice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'boiled' scrambles rice to give E C I R, and 'in' sets the city inside it; 'Culinary delight' is the definition, 'of' a link.
explanation.definitionFit: An éclair is a cream-filled choux pastry, a sweet treat.

clue.text: Press hobby, for example, is old train

parts.note: to iron clothes is to press them
a hobby is an old word for a small horse

explanation.surface: Pushing one's pastime turns out to be a vintage locomotive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hobby' is not a pastime but a small, light horse.
explanation.definitionFit: Iron horse is an old nickname for a steam locomotive.

clue.text: To throw out high flier is not stupid

parts.note: a jet is an aircraft that flies high

indicators.note: stupid signals that the letters of 'is not' are muddled

explanation.surface: Ditching an ambitious achiever is not a foolish move.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stupid' rearranges IS NOT into TISON; 'high flier' is an aircraft, not a star performer.
explanation.definitionFit: To jettison is to discard or throw overboard.

clue.text: Levels of skills returning to volunteers

indicators.note: returning means the word for skills is read backwards

parts.note: arts are crafts or skills
TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve force

explanation.surface: Grades of ability shown by people coming back to volunteer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returning' turns ARTS into STRA.
explanation.definitionFit: Strata are layers, as of rock or of society.

clue.text: Girl lied about the worm

parts.note: Ann is a girl's name

indicators.note: about signals the letters of lied are moved around

explanation.surface: A girl told lies about the earthworm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' rearranges LIED into ELID.
explanation.definitionFit: Annelids are segmented worms such as earthworms and leeches.

clue.text: Political party getting isolated cheer

parts.note: Con is short for the Conservative party
sole means single or alone

explanation.surface: A party in politics finds its spirits lifted after being cut off.
explanation.definitionFit: To console someone is to comfort them and lift their spirits.

clue.text: Lots of people boast about doubtlessly suspect origins

parts.note: to crow is to brag

indicators.note: origins means the first letters of the words named

explanation.surface: Many brag about their questionable backgrounds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' completes 'crow about' as a link; 'origins' takes the first letters of 'doubtlessly suspect'.
explanation.definitionFit: Crowds are large gatherings of people.

clue.text: Out — when the French exercise comes up

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as I left'
le is French for the

indicators.note: in a down clue, comes up means the word for exercise is read upwards

parts.note: PE is physical education, exercise

explanation.surface: Gone out at the moment a French workout begins.
explanation.walkthrough: 'comes up' turns PE into EP.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone out cold or out for the night is sleeping.

clue.text: Belting opportunity for an opener?

parts.note: belting suggests a batsman hitting hard, but here it points to a belt-like sash cord, and the opener is anyone wanting fresh air

explanation.surface: A cricket opening batsman gets the chance to hit out.
explanation.walkthrough: An opener in cricket is a batsman who starts the innings; 'belting' hints at a sash and the opening is a pane that slides up.
explanation.definitionFit: A window with sliding frames hung on cords lets someone open it for air.

clue.text: Fail to finish trip and leave for town

indicators.note: fail to finish means the last letter of the word for trip is dropped

parts.note: to slip is to trip or stumble
to go is to leave

explanation.surface: Not completing a journey and departing for a town.
explanation.walkthrough: SLIGO is a town in north-west Ireland.
explanation.definitionFit: Sligo is a county town in the west of Ireland, a named place.

clue.text: Queen could be absorbing hot gossip

indicators.note: absorbing means the outer word takes the next piece into it

parts.note: a queen is a female cat
H is the abbreviation for hot, as on taps

explanation.surface: The monarch may be taking in some juicy rumours.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Queen' is not royalty but a female cat.
explanation.definitionFit: Chat is light, informal talk, often about others.

clue.text: Can sources of alcohol be licensed? Exactly

indicators.note: sources means the starts of the words that follow

explanation.surface: Can drinks be sold legally? Precisely.
explanation.definitionFit: Being able to do something means one can do it.

clue.text: Used to be one way to live

parts.note: ex means former, something that used to be
I is the Roman numeral for one
St is short for street, a way

explanation.surface: Being a former partner is a way of getting by.
explanation.definitionFit: To exist is to be alive and have being.

clue.text: Mistress Peacock's garden pest controllers

parts.note: a lady is the mistress of a household
a peacock is one of the birds, the 's making it plural here

explanation.surface: A woman named Peacock owns the insects that keep the garden clear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mistress Peacock' reads as a person's name, like a character in a board game; split it into a title and a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: These red spotted beetles eat aphids, so gardeners prize them.

clue.text: Stick out for time — basic!

parts.note: pro means in favour of, for
rude can mean primitive or basic

explanation.surface: Persisting for a while in very crude conditions.
explanation.definitionFit: To protrude is to jut or extend beyond a surface.

clue.text: Cut off point for course

parts.note: to sever is to cut off
N is north, a point of the compass

explanation.surface: A chopped point for a race track.
explanation.walkthrough: The SEVERN is Britain's longest river; 'course' is a watercourse.
explanation.definitionFit: A river is a watercourse, and this one runs from Wales to the Bristol Channel.
